logic_errors.issue: The native pointer remains authoritative after falling back to the legacy window.
logic_errors.recommendation: Clear remote_pointer when relinquishing native input ownership and ensure local pointer events restore local-pointer authority.

logic_errors.issue: Native-window failure during a cinematic bypasses window restoration.
logic_errors.recommendation: Route cinematic native-display loss through the same ownership cleanup and legacy-window restoration used by ordinary gameplay before drawing the fallback.

summary: Independent read-only review found two concrete fallback logic errors and no security concerns.
